purpose: Teach: 桂/柏/藍/圭/乃/嘉/肇/ヨウ

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、家族で桂川のキャンプ行ったろ
lines.en: Hey, didn't your family go camping at Katsura River?
lines.style: Light, teasing opener. Direct address with a knowing smile. Building energy like she's about to land something. Quick pace, confident.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、給食で柏餅出てて喜んでたな、桜
lines.en: You were pretty happy about getting kashiwa mochi at lunch, remember?
lines.style: Relaxed deflection, almost amused. Side-eye delivery. Not quite meeting her gaze — turning it back on her. Small, private smirk underneath.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、藍色の制服シャツ気に入ってたな
lines.en: Didn't you say you really liked that indigo uniform shirt?
lines.style: Playful persistence, narrowing focus. Teasing but not mean. Each detail lands with a light tap of satisfaction. Building a pattern he's noticed.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、隣のクラスの圭くんと仲良いな、桜
lines.en: You've gotten pretty close with Kei from the class next door, haven't you?
lines.style: Casual observation delivered with careful lightness. Testing water. Watching her reaction more than making a statement. Softer than his last volley.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、ペットの名前「美乃」にしたって聞いたぞ
lines.en: I heard you named your pet Mino.
lines.style: Direct hit, controlled smile. Matching her teasing energy exactly. Not gloating, just even. Keeps her off-balance by showing he notices too.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、日本史で嘉永年間覚えてたな、桜
lines.en: You memorized the Kaei era for Japanese history, didn't you?
lines.style: Slight surprise in the observation. Quieter than before — genuinely noticing something real about her. Less teasing, more curious. Genuine.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、文化祭の標語「青春の肇」って書いてたな
lines.en: You wrote 'The Beginning of Youth' for the culture festival motto.
lines.style: Simple statement of something he observed. Not accusatory — almost tender. Delivered like a small confession. Quiet admiration underneath.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、保健室でヨウ素塗ってもらってたろ、桜
lines.en: Didn't the nurse put iodine on you in the clinic?
lines.style: Wry close-out, almost a whisper. Matching her tone from the start but softer now. Like he's showing his hand too — that he notices her like she notices him.
